target.title: feat(ios): implement branded design system in SwiftUI
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The iOS app had no centralized design system aligned with the branded styling guide: inconsistent colors (system blue/orange/green), inline system fonts, duplicated toggle UI, and ad-hoc spacing/radius values across onboarding, settings, chat, talk, and gateway screens.

## Why This Change Was Made

This implements the design guide directly in SwiftUI as shared tokens and components, without changing navigation or product behavior. It adds Claw Red/Teal brand colors, bundled Plus Jakarta Sans / DM Sans / JetBrains Mono fonts with Dynamic Type, spacing/radius/motion tokens, shared toggle/badge/banner/button components, and migrates ~30 views to the new system.

## User Impact

- Onboarding, settings, chat, talk, and gateway screens use consistent branded typography, colors, and button hierarchy
- Chat user bubbles use Claw Red instead of system blue in light mode
- Status indicators (privacy permissions, gateway pill) use semantic brand badges
- No workflow or feature behavior changes

## Evidence

### Screenshot methodology (corrected)

Initial before shots were invalidated — they reused Xcode DerivedData from the after build. **Before images below were re-captured from a clean build** of `upstream/main` at `c032f9809d` (verified: no `PlusJakartaSans*.ttf` in app bundle). After images are from a clean build of this branch at `b0eb41da67` (14 bundled font files present). Both use `OpenClawSnapshotUITests/testConnectedGatewayTabs` with `--openclaw-screenshot-mode` on iPhone 17 Pro simulator.

**Visible delta example (Chat header):** main shows a green checkmark icon; this PR shows the `OpenClawStatusBadge` "Connected" pill.

### Settings

| ![settings before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/before/05-settings-connected.png?v=2) | ![settings after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/after/05-settings-connected.png?v=2) |

### Control + Agent

|---|---|---|
| Control | ![control before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/before/01-control-connected.png?v=2) | ![control after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/after/01-control-connected.png?v=2) |
| Agent | ![agent before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/before/04-agent-connected.png?v=2) | ![agent after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/after/04-agent-connected.png?v=2) |

### Validation commands

```bash
# Verify main has no bundled fonts, branch does:
git checkout upstream/main && pnpm ios:gen
cd apps/ios && xcodebuild -project OpenClaw.xcodeproj -scheme OpenClaw \
  -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro" build
ls Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/OpenClaw.app/PlusJakartaSans*.ttf  # expect: none

git checkout feat/ios-design-system && rm -rf ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/OpenClaw-*
pnpm ios:gen && cd apps/ios && xcodebuild ... build
ls Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/OpenClaw.app/PlusJakartaSans*.ttf  # expect: 6 files

# Typography tests
xcodebuild test -scheme OpenClaw -only-testing:OpenClawTests/OpenClawTypographyTests
```

- iOS simulator build: **BUILD SUCCEEDED**
- `OpenClawTypographyTests`: **2/2 passed**

## Real behavior proof (required for external PRs)

- Behavior or issue addressed: Branded iOS design system (colors, typography, spacing, shared components) applied across primary tabs
- Real environment tested: macOS, Xcode iOS Simulator (iPhone 17 Pro), Debug build; before from `upstream/main` @ `c032f9809d`, after from this branch @ `b0eb41da67`
- Exact steps or command run after this patch: clean DerivedData, build each ref separately, run `OpenClawSnapshotUITests/testConnectedGatewayTabs` with `--openclaw-screenshot-mode`; plus `OpenClawTypographyTests`
- Evidence after fix: before/after PNGs linked above (assets branch `pr-assets/ios-design-system`, commit `7b2a998`)
- Observed result after fix: custom fonts in after build only; chat header changes from checkmark to Connected badge; branded typography on all tabs
- What was not tested: physical device walkthrough, light mode matrix, iPad layouts
- Proof limitations: screenshot fixture mode, not live gateway pairing

— [Joel Nishanth](https://offlyn.ai) · [offlyn.AI](https://offlyn.ai)
